title: Millet Lions Memorial Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Why go any further? Camp in the heart of Alberta's prettiest town, in a Lions campground nestled in a dense tree belt, we offer 10 power/water/sewer, and 20 power/water pull-through stalls, tenting/dryland sites, all with fire pits, picnic tables and firewood available. Public RV Dump Station, Public water fill station, and RV storage.
